name: open_ports
description: Show all listening ports and which process owns them
task_prompt:
Write a Python script using psutil.net_connections(kind='inet') to list all LISTEN-state ports.
For each connection get the owning process name via psutil.Process(pid).
Columns: Proto | Local Address | Port | PID | Process Name
Sort by port number. Handle AccessDenied for system processes.
Print as an ASCII table.
